affected_predicate.description: Mattermost is accessed so the required deadline reconciliation actions can be performed.

competing_trace_defects.description: The trace leaves the Mattermost login screen for the home screen, opens Chrome, searches for “mattermost,” and enters a Google reCAPTCHA flow instead of accessing the specified Mattermost server.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 41, the repeated instruction to select the top-left car tile is executed at the far-right tile. Subsequent actions remain within CAPTCHA image challenges and the final observation returns to the reCAPTCHA checkbox; no observed action accesses Mattermost or begins reconciliation.

summary: The reused action remains part of an unbroken CAPTCHA-selection loop; the trace never visibly returns to Mattermost or performs the requested reconciliation work.
